notes: County zoning layer (Zoning, 7128 polygons) from the county Planning_General_Features MapServer, the layer the county zoning web map draws. Covers unincorporated Lassen County; no jurisdiction field, so Susanville polygons may be present; ZONING_1 is the base zone (MASTER_ZONE is the master zone code), ORDINANCE is an ordinance number, not a URL. Combining overlays in COMBINING_1..3.
